subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

Why did they have to postpone the crucial board meeting until further notice?

options.text: Why the crucial board meeting had to be postponed until further notice by them?
Why the crucial board meeting was postponed until further notice?
Why had the crucial board meeting to be postponed until further notice by them?
Why did the crucial board meeting have to be postponed until further notice?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Why did they have to postpone the crucial board meeting until further notice?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the crucial board meeting" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "did have to postpone" to "did have to be postponed."
 
• Ensure the question structure is retained with "why" at the beginning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Why did the crucial board meeting have to be postponed until further notice?"*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Why the crucial board meeting had to be postponed until further notice by them?" – Incorrect structure of the question.
 
• **Option 2: **"Why the crucial board meeting was postponed until further notice?" – Incorrect as it omits the modal "have to."
 
• **Option 3: **"Why had the crucial board meeting to be postponed until further notice by them?" – Incorrect tense and awkward phrasing.
